name: corner_radius_top
expr: if(top_shape == 2, top_apothem - round_gap, min(0.12 * top_width, 40 mm))

name: corner_radius_base
expr: if(top_shape == 2, base_apothem - round_gap, corner_radius_top * base_apothem / top_apothem)

name: anchor_radius_top
expr: min(min((top_apothem - anchor_inset) / polygon_factor, corner_reach_top - anchor_corner_inset), corner_reach_base - anchor_corner_inset - cable_lean)

name: plate_area_mm2
expr: cable_count * top_apothem_mm^2 * tan(polygon_angle) - cable_count * corner_radius_mm^2 * (tan(polygon_angle) - (pi / cable_count))

name: plate_holes_mm2
expr: cable_count * pi * (anchor_hole_r / 1 mm)^2 + 2 * (tab_width_mm + slot_clearance / 1 mm) * (thickness_mm + slot_clearance / 1 mm)

name: hook_area_mm2
expr: post_area_mm2 + flare_area_mm2 + tab_area_mm2 + elbow_area_mm2 + arm_area_mm2 + tip_area_mm2 - dowel_area_mm2

name: hook_moment_mm3
expr: post_area_mm2 * post_centre_y_mm + flare_area_mm2 * post_centre_y_mm + tab_area_mm2 * tab_y_mm + elbow_area_mm2 * elbow_cy_mm + arm_area_mm2 * arm_cy_mm + tip_area_mm2 * tip_cy_mm

name: slot_each_mm2
expr: (tab_width_mm + slot_clearance / 1 mm) * (thickness_mm + slot_clearance / 1 mm) + 3 * pi * (relief_r / 1 mm)^2

name: plate_net_area_mm2
expr: plate_area_mm2 - cable_count * pi * (anchor_hole_r / 1 mm)^2 - 2 * slot_each_mm2 - cable_count * pi * ((pocket_r / 1 mm)^2 - (anchor_hole_r / 1 mm)^2) * (pocket_depth / sheet_thickness)

name: top_offset_mm
expr: (hook_mass_kg * hook_centroid_mm - 2 * slot_each_mm2 * thickness_mm * 1e-9 * density_plate * slot_centre_y_mm) / (hook_mass_kg + plate_net_mass_kg)

name: outer_tension_min_n
expr: (vertical_pretension_n - load_moment_factor * load_n - weight_moment_n - load_n / cable_count) / cable_cos

name: base_plate_area_mm2
expr: cable_count * (base_apothem / 1 mm)^2 * tan(polygon_angle) - cable_count * (corner_radius_base / 1 mm)^2 * (tan(polygon_angle) - pi / cable_count)

name: total_mass_kg
expr: plate_mass_kg + base_plate_area_mm2 * thickness_mm * 1e-9 * density_plate + 2 * hook_mass_kg + 2 * fitting_mass_kg + 0.05 * cable_count

name: q_central_n
expr: (central_cap_n - 1.25 * cable_count * weight_moment_n - pretension_margin_n * cable_count - top_weight_n) / capacity_share_central

name: sway_k12
expr: sway_axial * lean_sine * anchor_r_mm * cable_cos - centre_lateral_k * sway_h_central_mm

name: sway_k22
expr: sway_axial * anchor_r_mm^2 * cable_cos^2 + sway_geo_outer * cable_count * anchor_r_mm^2 / 2 + centre_lateral_k * sway_h_central_mm^2

name: hook_vertical_flex
expr: lever_mm^2 * post_length_mm / (install_e_mpa * hook_in_plane_i_mm4) + lever_mm^3 / (3 * install_e_mpa * hook_in_plane_i_mm4)

name: vertical_ceiling_n
expr: min((central_cap_n - top_weight_n - load_n) / cable_count, outer_cap_n * cable_cos - load_moment_factor * load_n - weight_moment_n)

name: height_max
expr: floor(max(min(min(850 mm, 2.4 * top_width), height_buckling_max), height_min), 1 mm)

name: overlap_max
expr: floor(max(min(table_height - foot_height - 2 * sheet_thickness - 2 * hook_depth - 2 * clearance_gap_v, 2 * (post_length_max_mm * 1 mm + sheet_thickness) + foot_height - table_height), overlap_min), 1 mm)

eq: ((plate_area_mm2 - cable_count * pi * (anchor_hole_r / 1 mm)^2 - 2 * ((tab_width_mm + slot_clearance / 1 mm) * (thickness_mm + slot_clearance / 1 mm) + 3 * pi * (relief_r / 1 mm)^2)) * thickness_mm - cable_count * pi * ((pocket_r / 1 mm)^2 - (anchor_hole_r / 1 mm)^2) * (pocket_depth / 1 mm))

name: table_height

description: Floor to the top surface. Range follows the hooks, the rope hardware and the height the posts can carry.

name: top_width
label: Top width
description: Width of the top across its flats (or its diameter if round).

name: top_shape
label: Top shape
description: Polygon with as many sides as outer cables, or round.

name: cable_count
label: Outer cables
description: Number of outer cables, and sides of a polygon top. Also changes the anchors and the statics.

name: hook_overlap
label: Hook overlap
description: How far the hook arms pass each other: the gap between arm faces that the central rope spans.

name: cable_lean
label: Cable lean
description: How much further out the base anchors sit than the top anchors, each side. It widens the base, so the table is harder to tip; it stiffens the top against sway only a little (the sway output shows how much).

name: load_mass
label: Heaviest load it will carry
description: Mass in kg you will put on it, anywhere including the very edge: the cable tension is set for this load, so tension again if you raise it. Static only: never sit, stand or climb on it. One rope holds the top; if it or a hook fails the top falls. To tension: bring the cables just taut, turn all turnbuckles evenly to the turns shown, never past the maximum shown. Proof test: keep hands and feet clear and lower this load gently onto the edge over one cable. If that cable goes slack the top tilts while the other cables still hold: lift the load off, add a little turn to all and repeat, never past the maximum; if it still goes slack at the maximum, set a lighter load. Sized from supplier ratings and plywood design values; the eye nut is not derated for the lean, the cross dowel has no catalogue rating and the glue line is estimated: have it checked before trusting it near people.
group: Load: static only, never sit or climb

name: rope_set
label: Rope and hardware
description: Wire rope, turnbuckles, eye nuts: stainless 7x7 rope with matched fittings.

name: plate_wood
label: Plate material
description: Veneer of the top and base; the hooks are always birch plywood.

name: sheet_thickness
label: Plywood thickness
description: Sheet the plates and the hooks are cut from. Below 18 mm the 18 mm cross dowel in the hook arm no longer fits.

name: slot_clearance
label: Slot clearance
description: How much wider each slot is than its tab, for your CNC fit.

name: bit_diameter
label: Router bit
description: Sets the dog-bone reliefs in the slots and tab roots, so the corners fit.

title: Tensegrity table
description: The floating table: a top hanging from a hook on the base by one short rope, held level by three to six outer cables in tension. Set the height, the top's size, shape and cables, the hook overlap, and the heaviest load it will carry; the document works out the cable tensions and refuses a load the fittings or hooks cannot carry. It proves statics by closed forms and supplier ratings only: static loads, never sitting or climbing; a single rope carries the top, so a failure drops it; have it checked by someone competent before trusting it near people. Tension by the turns shown, never past the maximum, then do the proof test with hands and feet clear. It stands on a soft rubber strip at its rim: on an uneven floor a rim can wobble where three feet would not. Export: File, Export, Sheet of set Cut sheet (SVG or DXF), the plates and the hooks at true size.
